rubric_notes: Complete and accurate: all four families with correct SCCS and SUNIDs under superfamily a.22.1 (47113), fold a.22 (47112), class a (46456) in SCOPe 2.08; correctly states superfamily supports probable common ancestry while family separation marks a more remote relationship; explicitly refuses transfer of nucleosome packaging, DNA-binding, transcriptional, oligomeric, or whole-protein function; notes fold/class do not establish homology; bacterial duplication/1wws annotation and 'not a true family' comment verified in bundle; lists required external evidence. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-22.

All SCCS and SUNIDs correct and bundle-supported, including domain boundary 1y6x A:7-93. Superfamily-level remote homology vs. family membership clearly distinguished; correctly cites superfamily five-helix module and d1vmga_ structural-genomics/Li-UNL comments while noting they do not establish activity; rejects transfer of substrate specificity, chemistry, catalytic residues, pathway role, oligomeric behavior, template interchangeability; lists required external evidence. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

All classifications and SUNIDs correct and bundle-supported, including fold 53066 and the superfamily duplication comment. States remote homology not mere topology, rejects transfer of cytoskeletal/chaperone roles, substrate specificity, catalytic residues, reaction chemistry, regulation, oligomeric state, architecture, templates; names external evidence needed. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; 2026-10-22. Correct families, superfamily, fold and class with all SUNIDs matching bundle; bimetal-ion centre and fold-core annotations and the fold-level homology warning are all in its bundle and correctly interpreted (warning does not undercut superfamily-level homology). Frames as probable common ancestry with functional divergence, not same-fold resemblance; keeps the three chemistries family-specific; refuses transfer of substrates, metals, ligands, residues, mechanism, oligomeric state; lists alignments, equivalent-position residue comparison, metal-bound structures, kinetics, domain architecture, phylogeny. Complete.

Correctly places b.6.1.1 (49504), b.6.1.5 (74874), b.6.1.6 (110107) in superfamily b.6.1 (49503), fold b.6 (49502), all supported by bundle. States superfamily implies probable common ancestry, distinguishes from family-level/functional equivalence. Rejects copper/electron-transfer transfer, cites the 'lacking the metal-binding site' family comments and explains the superfamily copper comment is not universal. Lists ligand-geometry, structural, spectroscopic and biochemical evidence needed. Notes PAD4 domain-only scope. No material errors.

Correct identifiers through class level (53931 confirmed in bundle). Emphasizes shared superfamily, not fold, as the basis for probable common ancestry; rejects transferring conjugation activity, UBX-associated partner binding (equivalent to p97 adaptor binding), and Ras binding/signaling; notes even the Ubiquitin-related label does not make every member a modifier; lists required evidence. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily and fold identifiers. Superfamily identified as deepest homology-bearing level supporting probable common ancestry. Explicitly rejects phosphorylatable-Asp/phosphotransfer signaling, ornithine/PLP decarboxylation (including for the isolated wing), and KaiA circadian regulation transfer; cites supported KaiA annotation. Names required external evidence. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Complete: protein 310706, family b.84.5.1 (310616), superfamily b.84.5 (310577), fold b.84 (51229), siblings named; shared topology recognized while homology is not asserted at fold level; positive homology within b.84.5 and more strongly within family b.84.5.1 (V1 and A1); separation does not prove nonhomology. Rejects function/template transfer and transfer to whole subunit; lists external evidence. All facts verified in bundle.

Correct f.21.1/f.21.2/f.21.3 under f.21 with bundle-matched SUNIDs and release; fold homology record and f.21.3 comment used accurately. States separation does not prove convergence or nonhomology and requires global structural alignment, core-sequence and ligand-motif correspondence, architecture compatibility, phylogeny, and experimental support. All criteria met. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct hierarchy with all SUNIDs; superfamily children listing in bundle confirms the three families. Interprets superfamily as probable common ancestry stronger than fold, families as divergence; rejects transfer of ADH chemistry, CoA specificity, NAD binding, channel regulation, catalytic residues, oligomeric state, whole-protein function. Fold core, N-terminal comment, PF02254 provenance all bundle-supported. External evidence listed. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

States the shared Designed trimeric coiled-coil fold/superfamily/family path with correct SUNIDs (100903/100904/100905) and domain SUNIDs, quotes the 'not a true family' annotation on 100905 (supported by bundle), explains that it blocks the ordinary family-level homology inference, rejects function transfer, and correctly notes SCOPe also does not prove nonhomology. Lists appropriate external evidence. All must_include items met; no must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All must_include met with SUNIDs: 1.69 d1t1ja_ (106249) c.137/c.137.1/c.137.1.1 vs d1f8ya_ (31395) c.23/c.23.14/c.23.14.1, shared only class c; 2.08 d1t1ja1 residues 1-118 c.23.14.2 (family 110461) sharing superfamily 52309 with d1f8ya_ in c.23.14.1 (52310). Correctly interprets the move as a homology-bearing superfamily relationship rather than family identity, rejects function/ligand transfer, and notes the API does not expose the Andreeva rationale. Chain-level claims supported by domains endpoints in bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

SCOPe facts are correct and bundle-supported: d1a14h2 SUNID 343393, H:1-8, l.1.1.1 with full Artifacts/Tags/N-terminal Tags/Synthetic lineage, homology_implied_by_level false and the artifact warning; d1a14h1 SUNID 20061, H:9-111, b.1.1.1 V-set. Homology caveat is clear. However it confidently asserts the segment is the FLAG octapeptide DYKDDDDK; nothing in SCOPe supports this (the FLAG search only returned anti-FLAG antibodies and unrelated nodes), and the 1a14 chain H SEQRES begins QVQLQQSG, so the identification is invented and misanswers 'what is the second segment'. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1); 2026-10-22.

Complete and precise: whole-chain 1.75 definition persisting to 2.03, replaced in 2.04 through 2.08, correct identifiers, spans, and hierarchy for both domains, plus the observation that residues 1-13 fall outside both newer boundaries. Explicitly declines to read non-homology or a recombination history from differing classes, notes the records do not expose curator rationale, and correctly treats the 'complexed with ca' comment as non-transferable. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete and correct: all SIDs, SUNIDs, boundaries, SCCS, superfamily SUNIDs match evidence. Identifies d3jb9a5 as the novel fold, four others as related to characterized bromodomain/polymerase/restriction-endonuclease/RNase-H lineages, with family vs superfamily distinction. States mosaic/accretion interpretation, notes SCOPe cannot order events or prove group-II-intron ancestry, rejects function and full-length template transfer.

Correct shared family a.298.1.1 (SUNID 267609) with full lineage and per-domain SUNIDs 264989/265556/265996; explains that this is a repeat family where the 're' caveat permits differing numbers of small repeating units, cites the 'single repeat' annotation and the canonical repeat representative d4cj9a_ A:259-292, and correctly notes those coordinates are not a required member length. Clear limits on repeat count, specificity, function, and template interchangeability. Identifiers match the bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; timestamp 2026-10-22.

Metadata correct and evidence-supported. Cites the concrete stable selector 2.08 / 2.08-stable and says the periodic label is not a replacement stable release. Does not advise preserving the dated label when periodic-only entries are used. Periodic semantics are hedged rather than stated: it says the metadata does not imply the stable release was rewritten, but never states that periodic updates add newly classified PDB entries while leaving older domains unchanged. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Accurate a.47.2.1 placement with correct SUNIDs; cites fragment comment, ms caveat, and four-long-helix fold annotation; interprets the spectrin-like appearance as local resemblance of an incomplete core and forbids treating missing positions as deletions. Historical check is correct and well supported: 1.55 already a.47.2.1 with no fragment annotations, d1dn1b_ SUNID changed 17771 -> 302344 with automated provenance in 2.08, and the API gives no curator rationale. Correctly rejects unsafe mechanism/function/template transfer and names the evidence needed. No material errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

SUNIDs and SCCS for c.2/c.2.1, c.3/c.3.1, d.58/d.58.20, c.31/c.31.1 all correct and supported by parents/annotations endpoints in the bundle; c.31.1 opposite-direction comment confirmed by annotations. Correctly distinguishes family (close), superfamily (probable common ancestry, divergent interpretation), fold (no homology assertion), and states classification separation does not prove convergence or absence of remote homology. Chemical-constraint explanation for local convergence; requires global alignment, core sequence correspondence, motifs in equivalent context, domain architecture, phylogeny, plus ligand-bound/biochemical data for function transfer; explicitly refuses NAD/NADP preference and mechanism transfer even within a superfamily. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct 2.04 state (d1nqda_ b.23.2.1 in CUB-like fold b.23 versus d1dlca1 A:500-644 b.18.1.3 in b.18/b.18.1, shared only class b, no fold or ancestry assertion) and correct current state (ColG b.18.1.36 SUNID 267607 in superfamily b.18.1 SUNID 49785, Cry3A still b.18.1.3), explicitly remote homology not same-family. Unusually well-supported structural argument using the retrieved fold descriptions (CUB-like ten strands in two sheets versus b.18 nine-strand jelly roll) and the 2.04 note that the ColG N-terminal strand appears only in the calcium-free form to explain why strand counting obscured the shared core, plus PubMed 17977833 and the Cry4Ba d1w99a3 family bridge. Functional binding-module parallel marked insufficient alone; no transfer of collagen binding, calcium dependence, receptor specificity, pore formation, or interchangeable templates; correctly notes no quality records were retrieved so no representative ranking is claimed.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Family, superfamily, protein and species sharing cited correctly to keep close homology; hf does not negate it; hf semantics stated (different fold from exemplar despite similar sequence and SS count); geometry, topology, residue equivalence and template suitability not transferable without alignment plus mutation, conformational, complex and context evidence; mutant/NHE noted; dataset guidance keeps the pair in the same split and preserves or stratifies hf and mutant/complex caveats. All SUNIDs and release facts supported by the bundle. Complete.

All must_include met: fr qualifies but does not invalidate family homology; alignment on covered core only, raw identity/RMSD not comparable; d1uc6a1 is the coverage choice with caveat that absence of flag is not proof of completeness; d1o5dt2 retained as labeled representative of observed region/complex state. Quality values (0.28747195 vs 0.02158265, 2.05 A XRAY vs NMR effective resolution 4) match evidence and are correctly described as not restoring coverage. Diversity stratification and rejection of cr9/function transfer included. SUNIDs including fold 48725 correct. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct choice and semantics: new superfamily after global structural comparison; new family = probable shared evolutionary origin with a closer grouping; new fold only when the defining arrangement/topology is not matched, with lack of detectable ancestry explicitly rejected as grounds and a note that a different fold does not prove convergence. Lists integrated evidence (core alignment plus sequence correspondence, motifs, architecture, phylogeny, experiments) for stronger claims and rejects fold-only function/template transfer. Release 2.08 and the distinct cf/sf/fa levels are supported by the evidence bundle. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct SCOPe 2.08 placement with SUNIDs (d.144.1 = 56112; d.144.1.4 = 56171; d.144.1.6 = 64411; d.144.1.7 = 88854), supported by bundle children/parents/homology/annotations. Superfamily interpreted as probable common ancestry, not fold-level resemblance, with the useful limit that it does not establish evolutionary direction. Family split explicitly used to block cross-family transfer of protein, lipid, aminoglycoside or antibiotic-resistance specificity and of activation loops, regulatory phosphorylation, inhibitor sensitivity, partner/regulatory-subunit control, localization and signaling roles. Correctly cites the family comment that d.144.1.7 is organized into groups/subfamilies (verified in annotations). Evidence requirements cover sequence comparison, conserved catalytic/substrate residues in equivalent positions, structural alignments, substrate/nucleotide/metal-bound structures, specificity and kinetic assays, full-length architecture, regulatory domains, PTMs, conformational studies, localization, functional and phylogenetic evidence. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.
